summary: Iter22 frontend-only verification of the new SMS diagnostic X-ray UI on /admin/settings/sms. All 8 scenarios PASSED against https://slotnow-web.preview.emergentagent.com with mocked APIs targeting https://pro-booking-21.emergent.host. Dry-run and Send-test correctly POST {phone} to their respective endpoints, render the raw backend JSON inside admin-settings-diagnostic-panel/admin-settings-diagnostic-json, apply rose-tinted background + 'HTTP <status>' label for error responses, and are correctly gated by provider!=mock && enabled=true. Iter18-21 regressions (DLT alphanumeric preservation, PUT round-trip, live status card, payment page has no SMS diagnostic UI) still hold.
action_items: None for the diagnostic UI itself — it correctly surfaces the raw backend response. The underlying MSG91 backend bug is out of workspace scope and must be handed to Emergent Support with a screenshot of the diagnostic panel (which now shows the exact request/response).
critical_code_review_comments: AdminSettings.jsx: dry-run/send-test/save/close buttons omit an explicit type='button'. Default is submit; harmless today because there is no <form> wrapper, but if a form is ever introduced these will submit and cause a full page reload. Add type='button' to all four defensively.

First automation attempt clicked the dry-run button but the navigation went to /profile because the mobile bottom nav (fixed) overlapped the button at viewport height 900. Tests now use height=2000 + scroll_into_view; UI itself works fine, but consider adding bottom padding on the SMS diagnostic card (pb-24 on mobile) so real users don't misclick the bottom nav when the diagnostic panel is open.

diagnostic.error stores either the HTTP status number or the string 'network'. The label renders 'HTTP network' for offline errors which reads slightly oddly. Consider 'HTTP N/A (network)' or similar.
test_credentials: N/A - admin session injected via localStorage (slotnow_token + slotnow_user role=admin) with mocked /api/users/me.
seed_data_creation: None. All admin auth + settings + test-send + dry-run endpoints mocked via page.route().
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/tests/bug_verification_iter22_admin_sms_diagnostic.py checklist. Key gotcha: preview UI renders with a fixed bottom navigation bar; use viewport height >=2000 and scroll_into_view_if_needed() before clicking anything on /admin/settings/sms — do NOT use force=True on those buttons, or clicks will silently misroute to the bottom nav's Profile link and navigate away. Route registration order matters: register the more-specific /dry-run and /test-send routes BEFORE the /sms route so Playwright matches them correctly.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — this iteration is not a bug fix but an additive diagnostic UI. The user's real bug (backend claims MSG91 send succeeds but no SMS arrives) lives in the deployed backend at pro-booking-21.emergent.host which is not in this workspace. Iter22 gives the user a screenshot-able X-ray (raw payload the backend would send + raw success/error response) to attach when escalating to Emergent Support / backend team.
